title: The Ten Persian Digits
label: ch:fa-digits
canDo: I can read and write the ten Persian digits, read a price, a page number and a telephone number off an Iranian page, and say which way a number runs inside a right-to-left line.

payoff.summary: Ten signs across four lessons, grouped by what makes each pair hard: the reversed direction, the one-tooth pair, the three Arabic draws differently, and the mirror pair.
